title: Rigorix Ledger Receipt v1
description: ADR-016 anchor-signed ledger receipt: the anchor's durable acknowledgement that it verified and appended an envelope at a given per-producer sequence. Clients verify the Ed25519 `sig` with the anchor's PUBLIC key — the agent host cannot forge it (HMAC stays the local cache mechanism and is not an authority signal). No policy/matcher/verdict lives in the anchor.

ledger_id.description: Anchor ledger identifier (one logical append-only ledger per producer/tenant).

envelope_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the recorded envelope's canonical bytes (`signature` nulled) — the SAME value a successor stores in `prev_hash`. One canonical form, no second dialect.

sequence.description: The per-producer sequence the anchor assigned/verified for the recorded envelope.

recorded_at.description: When the anchor durably recorded the envelope.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (hex, 64 bytes) over the canonical receipt bytes (`sig` set to null).

x-signing.canonicalization: serde_json::to_string(receipt with `sig` = null) — UTF-8 bytes; no map fields, so field/declaration order is stable.
x-signing.publicKey: 32-byte Ed25519 public key, hex. The verifier takes it out-of-band; it is never carried in the artifact.
